y.contrast: The same symbol as German ü in "Tür", but said with the lips pushed forward; to German ears it sounds nearer i. Swedish u is the vowel closer to German ü.

u.contrast: Not German u: it sounds close to German ü in "üben", with the lips pressed together. Swedish y is the one with the lips pushed forward.

o.contrast: Usually the vowel of German "gut", not German o.
